newsitem.title: USA: Fast Air Cargo adds fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: Fast Air Cargo adds fuel surcharge.

text.p: Fast Air Cargo, the all-cargo Chilean airline, will add a 10 cents per kilo fuel surcharge, a Fast executive said Wednesday.
The surcharge will be effective Nov 15 to all destinations, the executive, who asked not to be identified, told Reuters.
The Santiago-based airline's surcharge follows most other airlines serving Latin America. The first surcharges started about Oct 1, following steep increases in jet fuel prices worldwide.

Fast, a privately held airline, carried the 12th most freight through Miami International Airport in the first nine months of this year. Fast flew 32,835 tonnes through MIA through Sept 30, an increase 14 percent from the first nine month of 1995.
